name: Hotel Neue Post
beschreibung: Hotel Neue Post is located right in the vibrant centre of Mayrhofen in Tyrol's Zillertal Valley. It serves as a premier base for summer hiking tours and winter skiing, with the Penkenbahn and Ahornbahn cable cars just a short walk away. Accommodations include comfortable rooms, an extensive wellness spa with saunas and relaxation areas, a stylish bar, and a restaurant offering fresh regional half-board dining.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Neue Post in central Mayrhofen in the Zillertal offers traditional comfort, a sauna wellness area, regional dining, and walking distance to the Penken and Ahorn cable cars.
